panels.title: Exporter can read Proxmox
panels.description: DOWN means the pve-exporter container can't read the Proxmox API (token, permission or certificate; runbook 'Monitoring').

panels.title: Guests running
panels.description: Virtual machines and containers that are on.

panels.title: Guests stopped
panels.description: Off guests (templates left out). Not always a problem: some are off on purpose.

targets.expr: count(pve_up{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"} == 0 unless on (id) pve_guest_info{template="1"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fullest storage
panels.description: The most-used storage pool on any node; see the Storage table.

targets.expr: max by (id, name) ((pve_up{id=~"node/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name) pve_node_info)
max by (id, name) ((100 * pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"node/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name) pve_node_info)
max by (id, name) ((100 * pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"node/.*"} / pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"node/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name) pve_node_info)
max by (id, name) ((pve_uptime_seconds{id=~"node/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name) pve_node_info)
max by (id, node, storage) ((100 * pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} / (pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} > 0)) * on (id) group_left (node, storage) pve_storage_info)
max by (id, node, storage) ((pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"} - pve_disk_usage_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (node, storage) pve_storage_info)
max by (id, node, storage) ((pve_disk_size_bytes{id=~"storage/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (node, storage) pve_storage_info)

panels.title: Virtual machines and containers
panels.description: This VM (grafana, which runs the website) is one of these.

targets.expr: max by (id, name, node, type) ((pve_up{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info)
max by (id, name, node, type) ((100 * pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info)
max by (id, name, node, type) ((pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info)
max by (id, name, node, type) ((pve_memory_size_bytes{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info)
max by (id, name, node, type) ((pve_uptime_seconds{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info)
max by (id, name) ((100 * pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"node/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name) pve_node_info)

panels.title: Busiest guests (CPU)
panels.description: Percent of each guest's own cores.

targets.expr: topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) ((100 * pve_cpu_usage_ratio{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info))
topk(8, max by (id, name, node, type) ((pve_memory_usage_bytes{id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.*"}) * on (id) group_left (name, node, type) pve_guest_info))

panels.title: UnPoller can read UniFi
panels.description: DOWN means UnPoller can't sign in to the UniFi controller (account, password or certificate; runbook 'Monitoring').

panels.title: Devices offline
panels.description: UniFi devices the controller can't reach (uptime 0). See the Devices table.

panels.title: Internet drops
panels.description: Internet outages the gateway counted (its own running total).

panels.title: Network areas (UniFi's own verdict)
panels.description: wan = the internet link, www = reaching the internet, lan = switches, wlan = Wi-Fi (warning when an AP is offline), vpn = VPN server.

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: uap = access point, usw = switch or PDU, udm = gateway.

targets.expr: max by (name, type, model, ip, version) (unpoller_device_info)

panels.title: Busiest clients (download)
panels.description: Traffic each client received in the last 5 minutes, as UniFi counts it.
